channel.title: One-Minute Focus Reset
channel.description:
One-minute guided exercises to bring your attention back when it's scattered: counting breaths, single-point focus, and short listening drills. Calm, practical, and not medical advice.

Made by Honest Little Apps, the makers of Attention Age: Focus Test, an iPhone app with a five-minute test to find your focus baseline and short daily training. Attention Age: Focus Test on the App Store

Narrated with a synthetic (text-to-speech) voice.
